posts.title: Structure of the Proposed EU KIDS Act — Age Tiers and Reversal of Proof Burden
posts.description: The European Commission proposed the EU KIDS Act to introduce gradual social media access, mandatory safety by design, and privacy-preserving verification.

posts.title: What Is Gained and What Must Be Verified When Models Edit Their Own Context — An Analysis of Context Language Models
posts.description: Context Language Models treat context as a file for model-driven updates. This analysis covers benchmark gains and Suffix Cache Reuse from the paper.

posts.title: From Vector Search to Multi-Search Engine — Why turbopuffer v3 Demoted the Vector Index
posts.description: turbopuffer v3 decouples document storage from its vector index, removing write cascades, storage amplification, and block size bottlenecks in queries.

posts.title: Event Streaming on Object Storage - The Design and Beta Boundaries of Cloudflare K2
posts.description: An analysis of Cloudflare K2 event streaming on R2: ordered offsets, a p99 1-second write latency trade-off, 5-minute leases, and public beta constraints.

posts.title: The Debate Over Git 3.0 SHA-256 Default and Real Transition Costs - Distinguishing Content Identity from Source Trust
posts.description: We examine the Git 3.0 SHA-256 default debate, detailing content integrity versus source trust, ecosystem breakage costs, and the tree checksum alternative.

posts.title: Expanding from CLI to Desktop - Cordis Architecture and Local Permission Tracing in DeepSeek Harness
posts.description: DeepSeek Harness launches as a desktop app on macOS and Windows. We examine its Cordis plugin architecture, document previews, permissions, and traces.

posts.title: How a Minimalist Terminal Agent Adds Extensibility in 1.0 - Codemode and Context Defenses in Pi 1.0
posts.description: Pi 1.0 brings extensibility to a minimal terminal agent. We examine how Codemode, virtual models, lazy tool loading, and cache warming curb token overhead.

posts.title: Returning Discrete Choices and Probabilities Instead of Text Generation — Cloudflare Clef Announcement and Comparative Analysis
posts.description: Cloudflare introduced Clef decision models returning discrete choices and calibrated probabilities with 64K context and 38.8ms self-reported flash latency.

posts.title: Defining C-ABI Variadic Functions Directly in Rust and Raw Pointer Layout APIs - Rust 1.99.0 Stabilization Analysis
posts.description: Rust 1.99.0 stabilizes defining C-ABI variadic functions via VaList, settles raw pointer layout APIs, and updates Box::leak memory deallocation guidance.

posts.title: Interpreting Security Advisory Metrics — 33 rsync CVEs and 1,313 Kernel CVEs in Debian
posts.description: Analyzing Debian security updates: rsync 3.5.0 fixing 33 CVEs with path restrictions, and kernel DSA-6528-1 patching 1,313 CVEs under upstream CNA rules.
